metricsPolicy.reachedRound: Highest team round entered, including the failed round.
metricsPolicy.sargonLayers: Terminal Sargon layer count, effective only if the last formation before elimination activated Sargon. The summary retains persistent counters after elimination; all games included.
metricsPolicy.leaks: Own counted normal-wave leaks before Unite, verified against player stats.
metricsPolicy.uniteKills: Actual counted enemy deaths credited by killer.ownerId to Zumama or her summons; deterministic replay of recorded Unite BattleSpecs, excluding teammate/environment allocation.
